# Feature Request

Thank you for helping improve the GitHub Copilot CLI course.

Use this template to suggest new lessons, hands-on activities, improvements, examples, or other useful additions.

---

## Feature or Improvement

Describe the feature, lesson, activity, or improvement you would like to see.

## Problem or Motivation

What problem would this feature or improvement solve?

Explain why you think it would be useful for learners.

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think this could be implemented in the course.

## Learning Benefit

Explain how this addition would help learners understand or use GitHub Copilot CLI more effectively.

## Example

If possible, provide an example of how the proposed feature or activity could work.

## Additional Information

Provide any other relevant information, references, or suggestions.

---

## Checklist

* [ ] I have searched existing issues to make sure this suggestion has not already been submitted.
* [ ] This suggestion is relevant to the GitHub Copilot CLI course.
* [ ] I have clearly explained the proposed improvement.
